# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version         | Supported | Description               |
| --------------- | --------- | ------------------------- |
| ^1.0.0          | ✅ Yes    | Latest stable release     |
| ^1.0.0 (LTS)    | ✅ Yes    | Long-term support         |
| ^1.0.0 (Canary) | ❌ No     | Development purposes only |
| Older versions  | ❌ No     | Upgrade recommended       |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please use [security.txt](https://hqsy.net/.well-known/security.txt) to report a vulnerability.

You can expect a response within 48 hours if you are a human reporting a genuine issue.

Thank you in advance.
